Generated by tools/figures/requirements_readme.py from requirements/SYS-*.yaml, safety/hazards/ and architecture/item-definition.yaml. Candidate requirements: not baselined, verified or accepted.

g.text: Terms: BMS = battery management system · ID = identifier · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-GSE =
ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release ·
SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors
(alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor (alternative B) · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint
actuators and stability sensing · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
